description: Стройте монументальные станции и базы с FramedBlocks, Chipped, Rechiseled (+ Create), Quark, Supplementaries, Amendments, Macaw's Suite (мосты, крыши, двери, окна, пути), Another Furniture, Handcrafted, Sully's Mod и Effortless Building.
